bug_semantics: Stored CWE-79 in Krayin CRM notes/activities: an authenticated user saves HTML/JS in a Person or Lead note; Contacts → Persons (and Leads) render that comment through <x-admin::activities> as HTML. At disclosure (v2.1.6) packages/Webkul/Admin/src/Resources/views/components/activities/index.blade.php bound activity.comment with v-safe-html (DOMPurify then el.innerHTML). The same sink was originally v-html with no sanitizer. Payload is stored in the activities table and executed/rendered for other users, including admins. CVE/GHSA text wrongly names Playwright helper composeMail in packages/Webkul/Admin/tests/e2e-pw/tests/mail/inbox.spec.ts and patch 73ed28d466bf14787fdb86a120c656a4af270153; that commit is an unmerged e2e flake wait and is not the XSS.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: GitHub issue 2419, vendor comments, and the merged PR 2542 describe stored XSS of note/activity comments on the Persons/Leads activities timeline, not a Playwright composeMail bug. CVE-2026-5370 remains PUBLISHED (VulDB CNA); GHSA is not withdrawn, so this is not FALSE_POSITIVE despite garbled VulDB file/patch pointers. Persons view mounts x-admin::activities, which at v2.1.6/v2.2.0 injected activity.comment via v-safe-html → innerHTML. Line and pickaxe history on the 2.x component show escaped interpolation until fabc2c41978bad04d16b0a9098dd6288e68e3a06 replaced it with v-html="activity.comment". Parent 4cd67c9947c7a31e1b2b6ffe0318fbcec57a5c62 was checked directly and lacks that sink, so parent-absent is false. That commit is a small single-parent functional change, not a move, refactor, revert, or squash. v1 had an analogous v-html comment sink, but the 2.0 rewrite deleted that file and shipped safe interpolation; fabc2c41 reintroduced HTML rendering in the new component and is the BIC for the 2.x advisory range. 4848b68 only renamed the directive to DOMPurify v-safe-html and did not introduce the mechanism. The CVE-cited 73ed28d patch is an unmerged e2e wait and is discarded. The content fix is df1f2fad55690d0860b2e9f7dc730085f075cb3a, landed on 2.2 by merge f96e2f71e4444909063509f3451e197edeef78b0 (PR 2542); first containing release tag is v2.2.4, after v2.2.0/v2.2.3.
